itens.titulo: Adding Nvidia During The Current Uncertainty is How Fortunes Are Made
itens.descricao: Adding Nvidia During The Current Uncertainty is How Fortunes Are Made Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - NVIDIA's revenue hit $96B last quarter, up 106% year over year, with Q3 guidance at $108B and supply tight through fiscal 2028.
- AMD trades at a P/E of ~229 with 56% gross margins versus NVIDIA's 75%, making it a pricier bet on a smaller AI business.
- NVIDIA has $279B in supply commitments and finances its own customers, creating real risk if AI spending stalls.
NVIDIA still expects revenue to grow approximately 70% in fiscal 2028 because it can't get enough supply.
Jensen Huang put it simply: "Our demand is much higher than that." Investors of every size who kept adding to a company like this have built real wealth.
Split-adjusted, NVIDIA shares went from $1.62 in October 2016 to $229.28 on October 9, 2026.
That works out to a 14031.78% gain.
Second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue reached $96.22B, up 105.8% year over year.

itens.titulo: Broadcom CEO says many AI investors are gamblers
itens.descricao: Broadcom CEO says many AI investors are gamblers Yahoo Finance
trechos: "Your parents give you $10 of tokens, you finish it in 10 minutes and you haven't learned anything," Tan said.
"That's what happening in enterprises today." AI companies including ChatGPT-maker OpenAI are reporting billions of dollars in losses as the industry works to establish sustainable business models.
Tan noted that OpenAI reached annualized revenue of $50 billion in September, which suggests a viable business model exists.
"So frankly, it doesn't tell anything at this point except that there is a lot of potential revenue growth out of providing frontier generative AI models," Tan said.
Australian data center company Firmus Grid Ltd., backed by Nvidia Corp., withdrew its planned $5.5 billion initial public offering last week.

itens.titulo: Seu próximo gerente pode ser uma IA: veja como Bradesco e Santander estão se preparando e se os apps de banco vão acabar
itens.descricao: Seu próximo gerente pode ser uma IA: veja como Bradesco e Santander estão se preparando e se os apps de banco vão acabar Seu Dinheiro
trechos: Para gigantes como Bradesco (BBDC4) e Santander Brasil (SANB11), isso não significa que o aplicativo perderá importância.
“O aplicativo continuará sendo superestratégico, mas seu papel tende a mudar”, afirma Patricia Kessler, diretora de Bradesco Experience, em entrevista ao Seu Dinheiro.

Eduardo Sasaki, diretor de Data e AI do banco, vê o aplicativo evoluindo de um canal em que o cliente simplesmente “comanda” operações para uma plataforma orientada a objetivos, capaz de recomendar caminhos e, com autorização, executá-los.
“O que a gente acredita é que o nosso canal continuará sendo estratégico.

A intermediação mudará; ela evolui, como sempre mudou ao longo do tempo, seja por novas tecnologias ou por regulação.” É por isso que, para Sasaki, o aplicativo do Santander deve continuar sim existindo, mas com outra função.
“Nosso app também vai evoluir — e já está evoluindo — de um lugar onde o cliente faz operações ou comanda o que quer fazer para ser um canal mais voltado para objetivos”, afirma.

“Quero investir esse dinheiro.” “Quero financiar um carro.” “Quero reduzir minha dívida.” “Quero organizar minhas finanças.” O banco deixa de esperar uma ordem específica e passa a interpretar uma intenção.
É ter uma assessoria e, se o cliente concordar, a IA executa um novo aporte de investimento ou uma mudança na carteira de investimentos desse cliente”, diz Sasaki.

itens.titulo: Lumentum, Astera Labs, and Corning to Demonstrate 1060 nm VCSEL-Based PCIe over Optics for AI Rack-Scale Connectivity at the 2026 OCP Global Summit
itens.descricao: Lumentum, Astera Labs, and Corning to Demonstrate 1060 nm VCSEL-Based PCIe over Optics for AI Rack-Scale Connectivity at the 2026 OCP Global Summit Yahoo Finance
trechos: The rack-level demonstration combines an Astera Labs Scorpio Smart Fabric Switch with Lumentum's 1060 nm VCSEL-based optical interconnect platform and Corning multimode fiber connectivity.
The demonstration will be available at Astera Labs booth #B34 from October 12-15.
The optical interconnect uses high-density 1060 nm VCSEL and photodetector arrays implemented with advanced packaging, including two-dimensional arrays with backside lens technology.

Built on Lumentum's ultra-high-volume manufacturing platform in 3D sensing for smartphone devices, it is designed to support high bandwidth density, strong signal integrity, and efficient optical connectivity for rack-level AI architectures.
The proof-of-concept system is designed to demonstrate multiple 32 Gb/s NRZ optical channels over Corning multimode fiber and an error-free PCIe-5 link.
"AI infrastructure is pushing optical connectivity closer to the compute system where reach, density, and power represent significant challenges," said Matt Sysak, Chief Technology Officer, Lumentum.
"This demonstration with Astera Labs and Corning shows how Lumentum's 1060 nm VCSEL platform can extend PCIe connectivity and unlock a whole new class of functionality."
